verdict.rationale: Issues are clearly a first-party GitLab object: agents turn issues into merge requests, Chat can access project issues, and agents can be triggered from an issue. Community users praise the issue tracking, and the GitHub importer brings over issues, labels and milestones, which implies native labels. However, no first-party documentation describes labeling, assigning, or tracking bugs, features and requirements as issue types. Missing for 10: first-party docs on issue labels, assignees, and issue types for bugs/features/requirements; corroboration of assignee support.
